Intermediate.learningGoal: Implement a finite state machine with transitions, enter/exit hooks and guarded events.
gotchas: Transitions to the same state: should enter/exit fire again?
Invalid events should be ignored or reported, but consistently
Hooks must fire in order: exit old, then enter new
goodSolutionShows: Enter and exit callbacks recorded in tests
Pure logic with dt passed to update
shapeHints: an enemy AI with idle, chase and attack states
a menu flow with pause and resume
a door with open, closed and locked states

Advanced.learningGoal: Build a hierarchical or pushdown state machine with timers driven by dt.
gotchas: Pushing a state must pause but not exit the one below
Timers accumulate dt and may overshoot, so carry over the remainder
Transition requested inside update should apply after the update completes
goodSolutionShows: Stack of states with pause/resume semantics
Deferred transition applied once per update
shapeHints: a pause menu pushed over gameplay
a boss with phases advancing after N seconds of dt
a character with stun and invulnerability timers
